name: JGRAFT namespaces
desc: Covers the JGRAFT action namespaces and the CONST, STASH, and EXPR expressions. CONST declarations and references, sequential evaluation, lexical inheritance and shadowing, STASH lifetime and mutation, and transferring parent stash values into constants before an inner JGRAFT resets its stash. Namespaces are logically independent trees: edits through copied or moved values must not mutate constants, saved snapshots, sibling values, or the original input. Supporting COPY, MOVE, SPLICE, AT, MATCH, IF, SPLIT, and EXISTS expose scope boundaries without prescribing storage or resource-counter totals. Expression coverage also includes literal reference patterns in ordinary, sequence, and regex matching; function operands; empty and mixed path expansion; scalar and array boundaries; selector syntax/runtime errors; destination restrictions; and preserved SPLIT metadata. Common expression declarations and EXPR cover delayed evaluation, invocation-time bindings, inheritance and shadowing, flat computed names, validation, independent results, and bounded recursive expansion. Detailed EXPR interactions with individual matching and function contexts remain in those contexts' suites.

Reference path expansion and validation
tests.desc: Every selector is a value-context operand. Array-valued operands expand exactly one level, empty expansions consume no selectors, and leading integer coercion applies after expansion. Literal invalid selector values are syntax errors; input-derived invalid values are operand errors. Resolution failures never create namespace properties.

tests.desc: JGRAFT expr declarations store unevaluated value-construction syntax. EXPR selects one definition and evaluates it when invoked.
